strings: When other cats vent to m_c, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} tend to give solutions rather than comfort. The medicine cat proposes that m_c is a puzzled heart.
m_c admits that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} never been able to read emotions, much less empathize with them.
Every morning, m_c practices forming different facial expressions and body language. Why must emotions be so complicated?
